objective: 请对当前 Quant 系统进行一次**从真实可运行闭环出发的全面审查、重构、验证与持续优化**，最终目标不是增加更多模块、策略、Agent 或“自我进化”概念，而是建立一个能够在严格风险约束下，从真实市场数据出发，完成 **observe → understand → generate decision → risk check → execute → broker fill → reconcile → PnL attribution → counterfactual evaluation → reflection → hypothesis → candidate strategy/model → offline validation → shadow/probation → live validation → promote/scale/pause/retire → repeat** 的完整自动闭环，并最终用长期、prospective、after-cost、risk-adjusted live net PnL 判断系统是否真正产生价值。第一步不要继续开发新功能，而是从代码、配置、数据库、journal、strategy registry、模型、文档和实际运行路径出发，对整个 repository 做一次事实级审查：明确每一个已经设计、实现或文档中声明的组件到底是否被真实调用、是否影响生产决策、是否有数据输入输出、是否存在只写了但从未使用的 dead code / unused feature / unused strategy / unused model / unused reflection / unused lifecycle / unused risk rule / duplicated abstraction / wrapper / historical path，并将所有能力分类为 **actively used / partially wired / implemented but unused / obsolete / duplicated / broken / missing**；特别检查“看起来已经有”但实际上没有进入真实交易闭环的功能，禁止把配置存在、函数存在、测试存在或文档存在等同于功能真正有效。随后以**最小可靠闭环优先**为原则进行重构，严格执行 **delete → merge → simplify → reuse → repair → only then add**：先删除或隔离无效和重复路径，统一唯一的数据流、控制流、状态来源、PnL ledger、strategy lifecycle、experiment registry、execution truth 和运行入口，确保主系统能够稳定完成一轮真实 end-to-end cycle，并为每一步建立明确输入、输出、责任边界、失败行为、日志、provenance 和自动测试。优先补齐当前真正决定系统能否学习的基础设施，包括完整 fill/trade/position/strategy/model attribution、realized/unrealized/net PnL、fees/slippage/cost accounting、BUY/SELL/HOLD counterfactual ledger、market/regime context、strategy lineage、experiment ledger、失败实验记录、模型预测与实际结果对齐，以及 lifecycle 的显式 state-machine invariants；任何 promotion、mutation 或自主修改都必须基于这些可验证证据，而不是 LLM 主观总结。将生产系统与研究/进化系统彻底分离：生产层只负责 data → decision → allocation → immutable Guardian → execution → reconciliation，学习层负责 diagnosis → hypothesis → candidate generation → backtest → walk-forward OOS → robustness → multiple-testing/overfitting control → shadow → small-capital probation → promotion/retirement；LLM 可以用于 reasoning、failure diagnosis、hypothesis generation、strategy proposal 和 research orchestration，但不得直接修改 Guardian、global risk limits、broker credentials、kill switch、audit rules 或未经验证直接修改 production behavior。不要把“交易次数更多”“HOLD rate 更低”“策略数量更多”“LLM 自己改代码”作为成功标准；先解释每一次 decision 是否正确，特别是对 HOLD 计算未来 counterfactual outcome，区分 good hold、missed alpha、avoided loss 和 false trade。对所有已有 strategy/model 建立 champion–challenger 和统一 StrategySpec，自动检测 semantic/behavioral duplicate，阻止 strategy zoo 无限制膨胀；新 candidate 必须说明它解决了什么已经观察到的 failure、与已有策略有什么本质区别、用了什么数据、经过了多少次搜索，并记录所有失败 trial，避免自动 data mining 和 selection bias。整个优化过程必须遵循“**先跑通闭环，再提高正确性，再提高研究能力，再增加自主性，最后才扩大资金**”的顺序：Phase 0 先做到 syntax/import/tests/service startup/restart/recovery/broker reconciliation 全部 PASS；Phase 1 完成真实交易和 PnL attribution；Phase 2 完成 counterfactual 与 decision-quality evaluation；Phase 3 建立 strategy/model/experiment registry；Phase 4 建立严格 offline backtest、walk-forward、cost、leakage、stress 和 overfitting validation；Phase 5 完成 shadow trading；Phase 6 才允许 evidence-gated probation；Phase 7 根据 prospective live evidence 自动 promote/pause/retire；Phase 8 再加入 regime-aware portfolio allocation、model retraining 和 strategy evolution；只有前一阶段 exit criteria 全部满足才能进入下一阶段。每次修改后都必须运行统一的 `make verify` 或等价命令，至少验证 software、syntax/import、unit/integration、data integrity、point-in-time/no-leakage、PnL accounting、lifecycle invariants、Guardian bypass prevention、replay determinism、crash recovery、broker reconciliation、shadow/live consistency，并要求 `FAIL=0`；任何失败不能被 warning 或 fallback 掩盖。最终请输出并持续维护一份事实级系统文档，明确：① 当前真实运行架构和唯一 end-to-end data/control flow；② 所有组件的 used/unused/broken/missing 审查表；③ 当前闭环在哪里真正断裂；④ 哪些模块应该删除、合并、修复或保留；⑤ 每个阶段的具体实现任务、依赖关系、测试方法、exit criteria 和验证结果；⑥ 当前赚钱或亏钱到底由 signal、model、strategy、allocation、execution、cost 还是 regime 导致；⑦ 当前系统哪些能力已经有证据证明，哪些只是设计目标；⑧ 下一轮只选择对“真实 after-cost risk-adjusted live profitability”最有价值的 1–3 个改动执行。整个项目的最高原则是：**不要优化一个尚未闭环的系统，不要让无法归因的结果驱动学习，不要让未经验证的学习结果进入生产，不要用复杂度代替能力；先让每一条数据、每一个决策、每一个订单、每一美元 PnL 和每一次策略变化都可以追踪、解释、复现和验证，再逐步让系统自动学习和自动进化。最终唯一有效的外部成功标准是：在固定风险边界和真实交易成本下，系统能否持续产生可复现、可归因、经样本外和 prospective live trading 验证的正净收益，而不是回测数字、策略数量或自治程度本身。**

Implemented unrealized PnL - the last code item from deliverable 8. Only realized PnL was attributed, so a position the agent was holding contributed nothing to its own record and the account figure and the agent figure could never be reconciled even in principle: one measured closed trades, the other measured everything, and the gap could only be explained away. PnLEvidence now carries open_lots, unrealized_pnl, net_pnl and net_of_fees, with open lots keeping the strategy that opened them to match the realized side's rule (the strategy that opens a lot is the one expected to realize its PnL, which may not be the strategy that eventually sells it). Verified by the daemon writing it rather than by a script: realized 564.39, open lots empty, unrealized 0.0, net 564.39, net of fees 564.39 - the agent holds no SPY (account positions are BIL, TLT, XLB, XLE, XLF) so unrealized is 0 and net equals realized, which is the correct answer and not a stub, and the machinery is proven only by test against a live position because there is no live position. The refusal that matters: an open lot whose price is unknown is reported with current_price None and unrealized_pnl None, never valued at its entry price, because marking a position at its own cost reports it as worth exactly nothing - a fabricated number wearing the appearance of a measurement. This surfaced a real finding now visible in doctor: 29 shares were sold under trend-follow-sell-002 that no linked BUY can account for. The account holds no SPY so those shares came from somewhere the fill linkage cannot see - a pre-existing position, a fill whose client_order_id never linked, or a lot opened before the journal began. The 23 closed lots carrying the +564.39 are all fully linked so the verified figure is unaffected, but 29 shares of unexplained selling belongs in a health report rather than a payload field. It is explicitly NOT diagnosed: it needs the ORDER_FILL_CONFIRMED events for that strategy traced back, which is real work and not something to guess at. A test also caught the doctor implementation formatting unrealized unconditionally, which would have raised TypeError on its own history since every stored PNL event predates the field - the same shape as reading a JournalEvent as a dict; it now degrades to net alone. Diagnosed the 29 unmatched shares and found the most serious defect in the project. Traced back: the agent bought 23 shares, the account held 52, and a single SELL of 52 was approved and filled - liquidating 29 shares, 56%, of a pre-existing SPY position belonging to the account owner. The check that existed was necessary but not sufficient: "cannot sell more than known holdings" used the ACCOUNT's holdings, and the account did hold 52. It bounded selling to the account's book - the owner's book plus the agent's - and said nothing about which of those the agent had any right to sell. This is an asymmetry in my own earlier fix: bounding max_total_exposure to the allowlist was justified as "the agent can only increase exposure by buying allowlist symbols, so bounding the allowlist book bounds everything it is able to do." True for increasing, plainly false for decreasing - the agent can reduce the owner's position without limit by selling shares it never bought. Worse, the scoping change made that path MORE reachable, because a symbol the agent had never traded was previously not in its book at all. Everything the reasoning predicted held, which is what makes a one-directional error so hard to notice. Fixed: a SELL is now bounded by what the agent holds, computed in the loop from ORDER_FILL_CONFIRMED events rather than from the account snapshot (the account snapshot being exactly the number that let this happen). When the agent's holding is unknown - no journal, unreadable journal - the SELL is REFUSED, and that direction is deliberate: a missed exit is recoverable since the next cycle retries and the position is unchanged, whereas liquidating someone's position is not. An unreadable journal is recorded in loop._agent_holding_errors rather than swallowed, because a silent None is indistinguishable from a legitimate "the agent holds nothing" - exactly the reading that allowed this. BUY is untouched: a probe with no holding yet is the normal case and refusing it would stop the agent ever opening anything. Four existing Guardian tests encoded the old contract, calling review() for a SELL without the agent's holding and asserting approval; they were correct when written and are updated, with new tests pinning both the refusal and the fact that a SELL within the agent's own holding is still permitted, because blocking every exit would be its own kind of danger. Commit e7de021. make verify: 21 classes, 0 failed, 643 distinct tests, 91/91 audit, doctor OK, exit 0.

Freeing either would let minictrl install-service write permanent units. Both of those are user actions: freeing the quota and confirming the daemon may run unattended through the 09:30 EDT open. A requirement-by-requirement audit against the objective should be performed once the market has reopened and there is at least one provenance-stamped session on record.

Started the requirement-by-requirement audit and immediately found a real gap: the objective's success criterion is AFTER-COST net PnL, and cost existed in the research backtest but was completely absent from the live ledger - a grep for commission/slippage/cost_pct in evaluator.py returned nothing, and all 23 lots recorded 0.00 buy and sell fees. So the number the system reported as its result was gross, and on paper the broker charges nothing, so nothing in the data would ever have revealed it. The backtest cost model and the counterfactual cost assumption both existed and both looked like cost accounting; the live PnL simply had none. Now observed and assumed are separate fields: net_of_fees and net_after_assumed_cost sit side by side, because on paper the observed fee is 0.00 and a number called "net" that silently means "gross, because the broker is free" is a label that outlives its assumption. Cost is charged on the notional actually traded, both sides, attributed to the strategy that opened the lot - the same rule the realized side uses. Live result: observed fees 0.00, assumed 0.05% round-trip = 8.67, taking +564.39 gross to +555.72 after cost - 1.5% of the gain, small but not zero, and the criterion is written on the after-cost number, so doctor now leads with it. A cause row became false as a result: the attribution's cost row said NOT A FACTOR HERE justified by "the paper broker charged 0.00, so this figure is gross". That was true while the ledger charged nothing and became false the moment the assumption was added - a health report contradicting the number printed beside it. It now reports against the after-cost figure and states the assumption is not an observation. Two of my own errors caught: the cost test asserted 1.05 where 2100 of notional at 0.05% split across two sides is 0.525, so my arithmetic was wrong not the formula; and cost_headline was added by a replace whose target did not match, so it silently did not exist - caught by calling it rather than by reading the diff. I also verified the objective's per-step contract (input/output/responsibility/failure-behaviour/log/provenance/test): every stage does have a failure event type journalled (CYCLE_FAILED, REFLECTION_FAILED, CURRICULUM_FAILED, PNL_EVIDENCE_FAILED, plus FAILED status variants on OFFLINE_VALIDATION_COMPLETED and COUNTERFACTUAL_EVALUATED), so the logging half of that requirement is satisfied. Commit e2599e5. make verify: 21 classes, 0 failed, 652 distinct tests, 91/91 audit, doctor OK, exit 0.

Closed the second open audit requirement: failed-experiment records. The objective requires every failed trial to be recorded, because selection bias is invisible otherwise - keep the best of forty variants and report it as the only candidate and the number inherits the selection without showing it. Admission rejections were already recorded in production, but a backtest that failed its out-of-sample bar left NO trace at all: research/ wrote nothing, so a search could run, could fail, and leave behind no evidence it had happened. The obvious fix - letting research append to the production journal - would break the separation the objective also requires, for a good reason: a backtest that graded itself could then influence production state. So trials.py is a separate append-only sink in its own file that nothing in production reads, satisfying both requirements rather than trading one for the other. Writes are atomic with fsync; a write failure is reported by return value rather than raised into the caller, because the trial already ran and its value is in the result rather than the bookkeeping; a torn final line is skipped on read rather than costing the history behind it. The operator chose to re-adjudicate the five unapproved strategy files through the real gate rather than retire them, accept them retroactively, or leave the gate red. That is the right call: it produces evidence rather than a decision, and the gate could still refuse - which it did. tools/adjudicate_unadmitted.py is deliberately not a rubber stamp. StrategyAdmission.admit() short-circuits with "strategy_id already exists" for anything already in the library, so feeding these files to it unchanged would have recorded a verdict that evaluates nothing; each spec is instead judged against a library that excludes itself, the view it would have met had it been proposed fresh, so the rules decide it now exactly as they would have decided it then. The TREND_FOLLOW reference-price rule is fed the last price the journal actually observed (SPY 764.18 from alpaca at 2026-09-29 15:57:42-0400) rather than an invented one, because a gate that decides on a fabricated price is not a gate. Verdicts: REFUSE fixed-size-buy-001 (behaviourally identical to fixed-size-buy-002, ACTIVE -> RETIRED); REFUSE fixed-size-sell-001 (identical to trend-follow-sell-002, stays RETIRED); APPROVE tiny-fixed-size-001 (RETIRED -> PROBATION); APPROVE trend-follow-buy-001 (ACTIVE -> PROBATION); APPROVE trend-follow-sell-001 (PAUSED -> PAUSED deliberately). Two points worth stating plainly. fixed-size-buy-001 held all 16 of its broker-confirmed fills and the library's only broker-verified realized PnL, and the gate refused it as a behavioural duplicate, so the strategy the evidence accumulated under is not one the gate endorses; its realized PnL is untouched because it is realized, broker-verified and attributed by id in the ledger, and only forward selection stops. And trend-follow-sell-001 stays PAUSED even though approved, because PROBATION is selectable and PAUSED is not, so promoting it would have put a strategy back into trading as a side effect of closing a paperwork gap - approval makes a spec legitimate, it does not retract a risk decision. I introduced two bugs doing this and both are fixed. First, my repaired check demanded an ACCEPTED event for every file, so a spec the gate correctly refused and correctly retired was still reported as a bypass, leaving the gate red for having done the right thing; the failure actually worth guarding is a file that is in the library and tradeable with no verdict behind it, so REFUSED plus not selectable is now a complete disposition and REFUSED plus ACTIVE is its own and more dangerous finding. Second, I changed lifecycles without recording the decision, tripping _check_lifecycle_provenance - the check that exists precisely to catch a strategy reaching a gated state with no recorded decision. Worse, the three approved strategies then had PROBATION on disk against a June decision on record, and that check cannot see it because it deliberately exempts the default states PROBATION, BASELINE and ACTIVE, so a strategy can reach a non-default lifecycle with no decision behind it and the audit stays silent; that exemption is pre-existing and deliberate, changing it has a wide blast radius across existing strategies, so it is recorded as a known gap rather than quietly altered. The tool now writes a lifecycle decision whenever the current lifecycle is not already backed by one, not merely when the file changes - a re-run comparing old against new would have found them equal and left the gap forever - and a second pass backfills strategies whose admission verdict already existed, which is how the three approved ones were missed on the first run. Final state: all five files carry a dated verdict and a lifecycle decision matching the file; 8 tests cover the check including post-gate entry fails, genuine legacy stays a warning, refused-and-retired is accounted, refused-and-ACTIVE is not, and a bypass names the trading it caused. make verify 24 classes, 0 failed, 1061 test executions, doctor OK, exit 0. Commits a31c156 and 5562797.
progressNotes.next: Gate is green again at 24 classes / 0 failed / 1061 test executions / doctor OK / exit 0, and the five bypass files now each carry a dated verdict plus a lifecycle decision that matches the file. Next is market time, and one thing I found is worth the operator's attention before then: _check_lifecycle_provenance deliberately exempts the default states PROBATION, BASELINE and ACTIVE, so a strategy can reach a non-default lifecycle with no recorded decision and the audit stays silent - that is how my own first adjudication attempt slipped through. Changing the exemption has a wide blast radius across existing strategies so I have not touched it unilaterally. Otherwise: 70 decisions pending a 24h horizon, 10 SPY shares open at +1.05 unrealized, 0 closed model lots, no champion, after-cost net +556.77 still entirely baseline, and 29 unmatched sell shares still unproven PnL. Resume 2026-09-30 09:30.
